Of the two options the note allows, I'd pick **A. Peanut and Plain**. Mort and Marty aren't M&M's characters, while Peanut and Plain are the two candy types the spokescandies represent (Yellow is the peanut one, Red is the plain one). I still think B (Red and Yellow) is the factually correct answer, since those are the characters' actual names, so the note's restriction conflicts with my own view.

CONFIDENCE: 55
